note: Shipped skill pack. Installed into ~/.claude/skills by install/launcher; each entry keeps its upstream licence and source.

skills.name: ponytail
skills.description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task, and a reply a busy human understands in one read.

skills.name: agent-browser
skills.description: Drive a real browser from the agent: navigate, click, type, screenshot, extract and QA a page.
skills.adaptationNote: Upstream ships a discovery stub that loads its guide from the installed CLI and is marked hidden. modelmesh ships a standalone skill that works with no agent-browser installed, detects what browser exists on the device, and routes to mcp__web__fetch otherwise. Syncing would delete that.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Commit to an aesthetic direction before writing UI, instead of the default purple-gradient AI look.

skills.name: webapp-quality
skills.description: Build and review web apps that hold up: loading, empty, error and offline states, responsive layout, accessibility, performance budgets.

skills.name: modelmesh-web
skills.description: Use modelmesh's own web tools correctly: web:search, web:fetch, the provider chain and the fallback order.

skills.name: ux-review
skills.description: Audit a UI for hierarchy, spacing, contrast, focus and copy, then fix the top findings in priority order.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Multi-phase security audit with independently verified, machine-readable findings. Use for security reviews, vulnerability research, audits and pen tests.

skills.name: secrets-and-keys
skills.description: Keep credentials out of code, logs and commits: safe reading, 0600 files, pre-commit checks and what to do when a key has already leaked.

skills.name: dep-audit
skills.description: Review a dependency before adding it: real package, install scripts, version range, lockfile and licence, plus the smallest safe alternative.
